items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-01-10
items.q: whenever Mr. Mojie and those people had certain shows on

ctx.x: Would the vaudeville and movies go along all day, or just a...

It all depends. All depends on what kind of attraction it was. If it was a semi-risky thing, like with Lottipop Jones and those guys telling dirty jokes or whatever, well, it would probably be late evenings or at night. That would rarely go on in daylight hours, because really, whenever Mr. Mojie and those people had certain shows on, they would have out front that adults only or something of that nature. They practiced. They stayed within the law. They stayed within...
So when you say vaudeville, what do you mean?
